description: This file defines a class 'TestDefaultConfiguration' that manages configuration settings for testing environments, including loading configuration from environment variables, JSON files, and in-memory collections. It provides static properties to access various configuration values and includes methods for configuration setup and file provider serialization.

classes.name: TestDefaultConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing configuration management for testing, including loading from environment variables, files, and in-memory collections, with support for serialization of file providers.

classes.name: SerializablePhysicalFileProvider
classes.description: A serializable wrapper around PhysicalFileProvider to enable JSON serialization, with methods to access file system contents.

methods.name: InitializeDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default configuration settings by building the configuration.

methods.name: UseAadAuthentication
methods.description: Property that indicates whether Azure Active Directory authentication should be used, parsed from configuration.

methods.name: BuildDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Constructs the default configuration object by setting up host configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureHostConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the configuration builder with in-memory collection, JSON files, and environment variables.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, returning true if found.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileInAncestorFolder
methods.description: Attempts to locate a JSON configuration file in ancestor directories and adds it to the configuration builder.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileFromEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Attempts to load a JSON configuration file from a path specified in an environment variable.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures a test cluster builder with host configuration.
